How it works

  1. Build your quote

    Create a quote to accurately calculate the total cost for your service.

  2. Book your slot

    Once you've created your quote, book a time that works for you. Drop them off, or I'll come pick them up — whichever you chose.

  3. The cleaning

    Unlaced, insole removed, brushed by hand, treated and dried properly. Then laced back up with consideration towards presentation.

  4. Back in your hands

    You get an SMS once your pairs are ready. Payment is taken then.
